# Jenasaro

Jenasaro is construction planning, production management and execution-control software for connecting project schedules with work readiness, field delivery and management analytics.

Canonical website: https://jenasaro.com/

## Core positioning
- Project planning
- Construction scheduling
- Production management
- Execution control
- Project controls
- Daily production planning
- Constraint and work-readiness management
- Milestone management
- Resource and team planning
- Construction analytics

- Primavera P6 production planning: https://jenasaro.com/primavera-p6

## Platform capabilities
Jenasaro connects schedule logic and baselines, look-ahead planning, work readiness, daily commitments, planned-versus-actual execution, constraints, milestones, team capacity, subcontractor coordination, Primavera P6 import, drawing-based workfront planning and management project-performance analytics. Management views can include plan reliability/PPC, contractor KPIs, milestone trends, reasons for variance, constraint ageing, resource conflicts, escalation flags and report-ready summaries.

Lean construction, Last Planner, PPC and takt planning are supported methodologies within the broader planning and execution-control workflow.
